name: Digitide Solutions Ltd
title: Digitide Solutions Ltd - 544413 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Digitide Q4 FY26 revenue INR 800 cr (+9.2% YoY), EBITDA margin 11% flat QoQ; FY27 guide of ~100bps exit margin expansion and early-to-mid-teens growth, but reported PAT only 2.3% and D&A jumped on leases.

triggers.label: FY27 ~100bps margin expansion by Q4 exit
triggers.quote: We are looking at a strong 100-basis point expansion by the time we exit FY27.

triggers.label: Q4 TCV INR 620 cr; FY26 TCV INR 2,355 cr
triggers.quote: we closed Q uarter 4 with TC V bookings of INR 620 crores

triggers.label: DSO 91 → 75 days
triggers.quote: DSO improved by four days sequentially to 75 days in Quarter 4

triggers.label: Q4 PAT only INR 11 cr adjusted, reported -5 cr
triggers.quote: Reported PAT for Quarter 4 FY26 was INR (-5) crores, impacted by an exceptional charge of INR 16 crores.

guidance.quote: We are looking at a strong 100-basis point expansion by the time we exit FY27.
it should be around INR 40 crores on a recurring basis, which will be consistent.

guidance.value: at least one acquisition this year
guidance.quote: We are hopeful that this year we will be able to make at least one acquisition.
we have to go at about 15% CAGR
you should assume around 70% of cash conversion from the EBITDA.

prior_guidance_check.quote: even in Q4, your margins are flat.

red_flags.label: Reported PAT negative in Q4; adj PAT 2.3% margin
red_flags.quote: Reported PAT for Quarter 4 FY26 was INR (-5) crores

red_flags.label: Lease costs excluded from EBITDA; D&A jump
red_flags.quote: the Indian accounting standards mandate it to be reported

red_flags.label: Evasive on steady-state PAT margin
red_flags.quote: We can't give a specific number.

red_flags.label: Recurring exceptional items each quarter
red_flags.quote: in every quarter, there is some exceptional items

evasions.topic: Standalone vs Alldigi profitability / cost allocation
evasions.quote: it may not be fair to compare the standalone P&L and the consolidated P&L in isolation.
We can't give a specific number.
I hope I have answered all three of your questions
